title: Low Ratings on the Batch: Reduction Schedule for Wrong-Address Disputes, Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
**Clause.** Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the low-rating reduction in a wrong-address dispute counts the ratings of 2 stars or fewer received on the disputed violation's batch: 2 or more take off 2 points; exactly one takes off 1 point; none takes off nothing.

Ratings of 1 star and of 2 stars both count; ratings of 3 stars or more do not.

| Ratings of 1 or 2 stars on the batch | Low-rating reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

| Ratings on the batch | Counted | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 1 star, 2 stars, 5 stars | 2 | 2 points |
| 2 stars, 3 stars | 1 | 1 point |
| 3 stars, 4 stars | 0 | Nothing |
| No ratings | 0 | Nothing |
